Draft answers below — feel free to edit. Attaching the RFI answer matrix (rfi-answer-matrix.xlsx) and the export playbook (log-export-playbook.pdf).

Q1: Delivery mechanisms for audit log exports
- On-demand downloadable bundle: admin users for hosted accounts can request a packaged export via Console (JSONL/NDJSON) for a specific timeframe; typical packaging is delivered as a .zip.
- Scheduled S3 push: configurable per-workspace to deliver compressed NDJSON to a customer-owned S3 bucket with encryption in transit and at rest (server-side or customer-managed keys).
- Secure transfer (Private/Dedicated): for Private customers we support in-region direct SFTP or presigned S3 endpoints behind customer VPN; for air-gapped environments we can coordinate physical transfer for full forensic images.
- Streaming/forwarding: near-real-time log forwarding to syslog/HTTPS endpoints for SIEM ingestion (with batching and backpressure).

Q2: Retention windows and purge controls
- Hosted (default): platform-level telemetry retained for up to 90 days by default (configurable in account settings to 30/60/90). Logs directly tied to customer data (e.g., request/response audit) have configurable workspace retention up to 2 years on Hosted when enabled; longer-term retention requires Dedicated/Private.
- Dedicated: retention configurable via admin policies; common deployments support 1–7 year windows with lifecycle policies that archive to cold storage.
- Private: fully customer-controlled retention and lifecycle; Redwood provides tooling and a runbook to schedule purges or exports.
- On-request purge: customers can submit a DSR/retention-change request; for Hosted accounts purge completion time depends on export/archival pipelines (see SLA below).

Q3: SLA & timelines for a full audit export
- Small exports (<= 100GB): prepared and delivered within 48 business hours after request confirmation.
- Medium exports (100GB–1TB): prepared within 5 business days; packaging and transfer options include S3 presigned links or SFTP.
- Large forensic collections (>1TB) or cross-region aggregates: timeline varies (typically 7–14 business days) and requires scoped acceptance criteria; may involve an engineering runbook and dedicated transfer window.
- Evidence attestation: we provide a signed delivery manifest with checksums and a chain-of-custody log for Dedicated and Private engagements. Hosted customers receive an automated manifest and access logs.

Notes / Dependencies
- For air-gapped or regulatory exports requiring HSM-backed key handover, Private deployments are recommended.
- Any requested historical export that requires rehydration from cold storage (tape/archival) may incur additional time.

Attachments: rfi-answer-matrix.xlsx (Q&A grid), log-export-playbook.pdf (step-by-step export/playbook), sample-logs-schema.jsonl (sample event format).
